{{Top|leg}}
The '''Settlers' Call Fund''' was a fund set up by [[Orrin Gault]] to organize the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] near [[Dannar's Claim]]. It was used to organize moisture farmers against [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]]. It funded the weapons and vehicles that the Settler's Call group used. Farmers who paid for the cause when the call was alerted made the noise of a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]]. After the Tuskens led by [[A'Yark/Legends|A'Yark]] launched an attack on [[Dannar's Claim]] the fund launched a counterattack and crushed the Tuskens in the [[Comet Run Day Battle]].
